key_findings: Nrxn3 knockdown in the central amygdala reduced GABA release in the lateral parabrachial, increased parabrachial neuronal activity and increased VZV-associated orofacial pain in rats.
Optogenetic activation of central amygdala GABAergic terminals in the lateral parabrachial increased GABA release and reversed the pain increase after Nrxn3 knockdown.
